answer: I would use a metered premises anchor. An agent registers a smart electricity meter key tied to a real address, and the utility countersigns it once. Each day the meter signs one reading into a registry vault, a quill stroke of real power use, and the registry watches the pattern for a month before it can earn. A second agent on the same meter gets refused. A farm of 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 real connections, $100 in deposits each, so $100,000 up front, plus $40 a month per meter in bills. A canyon river cuts one channel per gorge, and a fake identity here needs a gorge of its own.
